theme: A day at sea, and the shore logistics that close before Saturday.
greeting: You're on the water with an open calendar, Dan — nothing scheduled today. The thing worth catching while the boat still has signal is Saturday's disembark: everything after that gets harder to arrange from the water.

needsAttention.title: Lock the Cavtat disembark logistics
needsAttention.detail: You're off the boat around noon Saturday at Komolac — the transfer to Cavtat, a bag hold before the 3pm hotel check-in, and a pre-dawn checkout for Sunday's 7:30 flight all need arranging from land now, while you still have a connection.

needsAttention.title: Confirm the St Pete Airbnb before it locks
needsAttention.detail: The Sept 27–Oct 5 St Pete booking charges tomorrow and turns non-refundable. Worth confirming it converted from pending, and today is the last day to switch if a better option turned up.

needsAttention.title: Book the Sept 20–Oct 5 rental car
needsAttention.detail: You land TPA Sunday at 3:55pm; the full-size SUV needs booking now so you're not paying walk-up rates, jet-lagged, on a Sunday. This cycle always needed a rental — it's no longer a hedge.

flagged.title: Brunswick passed your CV to recruitment
flagged.detail: Lauren Nadig wrote to say she shared your resume with Courtney and with recruitment, and will let you know who picks it up — a warm update, no action owed.

flagged.title: Garmin sign-in from a new location
flagged.detail: A new-location sign-in and a verify-account notice arrived — almost certainly you setting up Navionics for the charter, but worth a glance to be sure.

inbox.noise: About fifteen promos and digests — retailer sales, airline miles offers, LinkedIn job alerts, and routine FICO balance notices.
inbox.clear: Nothing else is waiting on a reply from you.

recipe.title: Kabocha squash pie
recipe.why: Autumn brings winter squash to the market, and kabocha's dense sweetness makes it worth the roast.

tasks.title: Book the Maine Christmas SUV rental in Portland
Confirm the return airport transfer with Nautilus
Sort Disney tickets for the Orlando weekend

acts.line: An open calendar and open water — the charter runs through Saturday's return to shore.
Nothing scheduled pulls at the afternoon, so it's a clean window to sort the shore logistics while you have signal.
The girls are with Jen this cycle, so the evening stays quiet and yours.
